name: Cosmic Curling
promptTemplate: A tournament curling match on {{ice_condition}} ice rendered in {{visual_style}} style with {{ice_speed}} speed and {{trails}} sweep trails.

ui.title: COSMIC CURLING +6
ui.tagline: Hurry hard! Slide and sweep stones onto the house

ice_condition.hint: Select ice friction and pebble density

visual_style.hint: Cycle cosmic rink themes and neon hues

ice_speed.hint: Tune launch velocity and glaze pace

trails.hint: Toggle luminous particle paths behind moving stones

sweep.hint: Mash to reduce friction and straighten the stone's curl

throw.hint: Launch the next stone down the sheet

listing.blurb: Two teams throw and sweep glowing granite stones down a dark cosmic ice sheet toward the house.
listing.prompt: Curling on a long sheet of pebbled ice seen from above: the teams take turns to slide a granite stone toward the painted house, and while it slides everyone on the throwing team can press 'sweep' to make it glide further and straighter; after eight stones the closest to the button scores. Two teams: tables alternate between them, or people alternate when everyone is at one table; show each team's colours and score clearly. Make it a party game a whole room can follow from across the floor: bold shapes and bright colours on a dark ground, every player drawn in their own hue, big short labels (a score, GO!, the winner) in a heavy font, and a large, satisfying reaction on screen the instant anyone presses. It must work with one player or forty, scaling its lanes, seats or pieces to room.people and coping with people joining and leaving mid-round; play itself in a lively attract mode whenever nobody has pressed anything for a few seconds; and after a winner is shown, start the next round on its own. Keep it lean: game state in bounded arrays in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080.
